actions: Remove the old filter element and clean
Install and torque the housing cap
canonicalStep.title: oil-filter-cap (BMW 328i draft Engine Oil & Filter Change guide; evidence step 3, 6, 8)

elements.describe: The oil filter housing cap on top of the 3.0L inline-6, drawn as a plain round cap.
The engine as a plain simplified mass around the cap.
The plastic engine (ignition coil) cover; RealOEM and Turner list one for the E90 N52, but its exact shape and fit are not established.
Unestablished detail of engine cover: An engine cover exists on the N52 but its exact shape is not established; it is left out of the picture.
